name: minecraft
group: games
url: http://mc-router.games.svc.cluster.local:8080/routes
interval: 1m
conditions:
  - "[STATUS] == 200"
ui:
  hide-url: true
  hide-hostname: true
  hide-port: true

0:
data_dir: /vector-data-dir
api:
  enabled: false
sources:
  talos:
    type: socket
    mode: tcp
    address: 0.0.0.0:6050
    framing:
      method: newline_delimited
    decoding:
      codec: json
sinks:
  victorialogs:
    type: http
    inputs:
      - talos
    uri: http://victoria-logs-server.observability.svc.cluster.local:9428/insert/jsonline?_msg_field=msg&_time_field=talos-time&_stream_fields=talos-service,host
    encoding:
      codec: json
    framing:
      method: newline_delimited
    compression: gzip

1:
---
modules:
  pon:
    http_client_config:
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true
    metrics:
      - name: pon_cpu1_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .cpu1_tempC }"
        help: PON CPU1 temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_cpu2_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .cpu2_tempC }"
        help: PON CPU2 temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_module_voltage
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .module_voltage }"
        help: PON module voltage
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_optic_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .optic_tempC }"
        help: PON optics temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_ploam_state
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .ploam_state }"
        help: PON ploam state
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_rx_power_dbm
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .rx_power_dBm }"
        help: PON rx power in dBm
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_tx_bias_ma
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .tx_bias_mA }"
        help: PON tx bias in mA
        labels:
          sensor: pon
      - name: pon_tx_power_dba
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .tx_power_dBm }"
        help: PON tx power in dBm
        labels:
          sensor: pon
